block.flora_cropberry.desc: A farmed berry bush, bred to be safe wherever it is planted. Harvest it for berries — it grows back on its bed, so a greenhouse never runs dry.
block.hydro_tray.name: Hydroponic Tray
block.hydro_tray.desc: A nutrient tray that crops root in without any soil. The growing bed of every high-tech greenhouse.

item.plant_fiber.name: Plant Fibre
item.plant_seed.name: Plant Seed
item.plant_seed.desc: Crafted from plant fibre (you won't find seeds lying around). Plant it to regrow harvestable flora — handy for a food garden, but you don't need seeds just to eat.
item.crystal_seed.name: Crystal Seed
item.crystal_seed.desc: Crafted from a crystal. Plant it to regrow a harvestable crystal.
item.berry_seed.name: Berry Seed
item.berry_seed.desc: Sown from a handful of berries. Plant it on soil or a hydroponic tray to start your own crop bed — the berries it grows are safe on every world.
item.hydro_tray.name: Hydroponic Tray
item.hydro_tray.desc: Place it and plant berry seeds on top: crops root in the nutrient gel with no soil at all, so a greenhouse works aboard a station too.
item.creature_meat.name: Creature Meat
item.creature_meat.desc: Edible — restores health and eases hunger. Dropped by creatures you hunt.
block.bed.name: Bed
item.bed.name: Bed
item.bed.desc: A simple cot of logs and plant fibre. Press E on it to make it your home spawn, and rest nearby to slowly mend your wounds — the low-tech forerunner of the heal tank.
block.campfire.name: Campfire
item.campfire.name: Campfire
item.campfire.desc: A contained, stone-ringed fire. Warms you against the cold, lights the camp, and cooks creature meat into a proper meal. It never spreads.
block.wood_crate.name: Wood Box
item.wood_crate.name: Wood Box
item.wood_crate.desc: A hand-built storage box of plain logs. Holds a few kinds of loose materials — the iron crate stores far more, but this one needs no workshop.
block.lantern.name: Lantern
item.lantern.name: Lantern
item.lantern.desc: A warm wood-and-glass light you can walk right past. Brighter than a torch, no power needed.
block.rug.name: Rug
item.rug.name: Rug
item.rug.desc: A woven fibre rug for the base floor. Dye it any colour you like.
block.flower_pot.name: Flower Pot
item.flower_pot.name: Flower Pot
item.flower_pot.desc: A small clay pot with a local flower — it takes on the colours of whatever world you place it on.
item.cooked_meat.name: Cooked Meat
item.cooked_meat.desc: Roasted over a campfire — far more filling than raw meat, and it patches you up too.
item.toxic_gland.name: Toxic Gland
item.berries.name: Berries
item.berries.desc: Edible plant food — eases hunger. Harvested straight from green flora; no seeds needed to eat.
item.toxic_berries.name: Toxic Berries
item.toxic_berries.desc: Harvested from a toxic plant — poisonous to eat. Scan flora first.
item.emergency_ration.name: Emergency Ration
item.emergency_ration.desc: Suit ration — auto-eaten when you're about to starve.
item.suit_teleporter.name: Suit Teleporter
item.suit_teleporter.desc: Recalls you to your ship, or beams you to an ally on this planet. Recharges between uses.
blueprint.suit_teleporter.name: Suit Teleporter
blueprint.suit_teleporter.desc: Craft a suit teleporter to recall to your ship or beam to an ally on the same planet.
item.oxygen_extractor.name: Oxygen Extractor
item.oxygen_extractor.desc: Pulls oxygen from a toxic atmosphere, slowing suit oxygen loss.
blueprint.oxygen_extractor.name: Oxygen Extractor
blueprint.oxygen_extractor.desc: Craft a suit oxygen extractor for toxic atmospheres.
item.stealth_suit.name: Stealth Suit
item.stealth_suit.desc: Cloaks you from creatures; drains suit energy while active.
item.advanced_scanner.name: Advanced Scanner
item.advanced_scanner.desc: A better scanner, rebuilt from your Hand Scanner — earns more knowledge per discovery.
item.mining_beam.name: Mining Beam
item.mining_beam.desc: A high-tier mining tool for the toughest blocks. Clears the surrounding area with the centre block and draws suit energy with every swing.
item.armor_chest.name: Armor Plating
item.armor_legs.name: Leg Armor
item.helmet.name: Helmet
item.helmet.desc: A reinforced helmet — reduces physical damage.
item.oxygen_tank_2.name: Oxygen Tank II
item.oxygen_tank_2.desc: Worn tank, upgraded from Oxygen Tank I — raises maximum suit oxygen by 100. Only your best tank counts.
item.oxygen_tank_3.name: Oxygen Tank III
item.oxygen_tank_3.desc: Worn tank, upgraded from Oxygen Tank II — raises maximum suit oxygen by 200. Only your best tank counts.
item.suit_lamp.name: Suit Lamp
item.suit_lamp.desc: A brighter helmet lamp for dark places.
item.suit_liner_1.name: Thermo Liner
item.suit_liner_1.desc: Padded suit liner — absorbs 40% of heat and cold stress. Only your best liner counts.
item.suit_liner_2.name: Insulation Suite
item.suit_liner_2.desc: Layered suit insulation — absorbs 65% of heat, cold and vacuum stress. Only your best liner counts.
item.suit_liner_3.name: Climate Rig
item.suit_liner_3.desc: Active suit climate rig — absorbs 85% of heat, cold and vacuum stress. Only your best liner counts.
item.jetpack.name: Jetpack
item.jetpack.desc: Hold Jump in the air to thrust upward; drains suit energy. Recharges aboard ship and at the heal-tank.
item.radar_scanner.name: Radar Scanner
item.radar_scanner.desc: Adds nearby contacts to the HUD radar.

item.scrap_pistol.name: Scrap Pistol

item.access_code.desc: A recovered Scout & Pioneer Service control code. Rare. Insert one to claim a station, factory or ruin as your own base — editable by you and your allies.

item.oxygen_tank_1.desc: Worn tank — raises maximum suit oxygen by 50. Only your best tank counts.

item.basic_drill.name: Basic Drill
item.basic_drill.desc: A simple drill for soft and common blocks.
item.titanium_drill.name: Titanium Drill
item.titanium_drill.desc: Mines harder ores such as titanium. Draws a little suit energy with every swing.
item.hand_scanner.name: Hand Scanner
item.field_medkit.name: Field Medkit
item.field_medkit.desc: A reusable medkit — right-click to heal yourself and nearby teammates. Costs suit energy.
item.stasis_projector.name: Stasis Projector
item.stasis_projector.desc: Right-click to freeze nearby creatures in stasis for a few seconds — long enough to scan them safely. Costs suit energy.
item.terrain_blaster.name: Terrain Blaster
item.terrain_blaster.desc: Right-click to blast a sphere of terrain to rubble — fast clearing, but it yields no materials. Costs suit energy.
item.terrain_scanner.name: Terrain Scanner
item.terrain_scanner.desc: Right-click to emit a scan pulse: valuable ores around you glow through the terrain for a few seconds — including underground. Costs suit energy.
item.weather_scanner.name: Weather Scanner
item.weather_scanner.desc: Right-click to read the sky: what the weather is doing here, what is coming next, and how far off the nearest front is. Costs suit energy.
item.creature_translator.name: Creature Translator
item.creature_translator.desc: Right-click a wild creature to read its mood and what it wants. Respond the right way — bait, calm, approach or give space — to earn its trust and tame it. Costs suit energy.
item.forage_bait.name: Forage Bait
item.forage_bait.desc: A bundle of plant matter that herbivorous creatures love. Used while taming.
item.meat_bait.name: Meat Bait
item.meat_bait.desc: A strip of fresh meat that lures carnivorous creatures. Used while taming.
item.nectar_lure.name: Nectar Lure
item.nectar_lure.desc: A sweet, salty lure that tempts gentle grazers. Used while taming.
item.camera.name: Camera
item.camera.desc: Right-click to photograph your view (without the HUD). Photos are saved to disk and can be browsed — and annotated — in the Photos tab of the menu.
item.paint_tool.name: Paint Tool
item.paint_tool.desc: Right-click a placed block to paint a 32×32 pixel design onto it. Save your designs and reuse them anywhere. Careful: mining a painted block loses the paint.
item.shape_tool.name: Shaping Tool
item.shape_tool.desc: Right-click to design your own block form out of micro cubes and save it under a name. Point it at a block someone else shaped to copy that form. Carry it to craft your forms from any material.
item.shape_stencil.name: Form Stencil
item.shape_stencil.desc: A form stamped onto a blank stencil. Give it away — right-clicking it adds the form to the receiver's library.
item.binoculars.name: Binoculars
item.binoculars.desc: Right-click to raise the optic and step the magnification (2× · 3.3× · 6×); another click lowers it. Costs no suit energy.
item.thermal_binoculars.name: Thermal Binoculars
item.thermal_binoculars.desc: Binoculars with an infrared sensor. Right-click to magnify, and press the thermal key while looking through them: living things, machines, lava and settlements glow through terrain and haze, with a range readout on every contact.
blueprint.oxygen_tank_1.name: Oxygen Tank I
blueprint.oxygen_tank_1.desc: Craft the first oxygen tank (+50 max).
blueprint.titanium_drill.name: Titanium Drill
blueprint.titanium_drill.desc: Unlocks crafting of the titanium drill.
blueprint.field_medkit.name: Field Medkit
blueprint.field_medkit.desc: Unlocks the field medkit: a reusable area heal for you and nearby allies.
blueprint.heal_tank.name: Heal Tank
blueprint.heal_tank.desc: Unlocks the heal tank: a regeneration unit for bases and stations that heals, feeds and recharges nearby players — and can hold your spawn point.
blueprint.stasis_projector.name: Stasis Projector
blueprint.stasis_projector.desc: Unlocks the stasis projector: briefly freezes creatures so you can scan them without being attacked.
blueprint.terrain_blaster.name: Terrain Blaster
blueprint.terrain_blaster.desc: Unlocks the terrain blaster: clears a large sphere of terrain at once (no drops).
blueprint.terrain_scanner.name: Terrain Scanner
blueprint.terrain_scanner.desc: Unlocks the terrain scanner: a pulse that reveals valuable ores around you, even underground.
blueprint.weather_scanner.name: Weather Scanner
blueprint.weather_scanner.desc: Unlocks the weather scanner: reads the sky and forecasts the next few weather episodes.
blueprint.creature_translator.name: Creature Translator
blueprint.creature_translator.desc: Unlocks the creature translator: decode a creature's mood so you can win its trust and tame it as a companion.

blueprint.radio_beacon.name: Radio Beacon
blueprint.radio_beacon.desc: Unlocks the radio beacon: a placeable marker that shows up on the map and compass with your own label.
blueprint.beam_block.name: Beam Block
blueprint.beam_block.desc: Unlocks the beam block: a craftable, named teleporter pad. Beam between your own and allied beam blocks on the same world.

blueprint.binoculars.name: Binoculars

blueprint.paint_tool.desc: Unlocks crafting of the paint tool for painting designs onto placed blocks.
blueprint.shape_tool.name: Shaping Tool
blueprint.shape_tool.desc: Unlocks crafting of the shaping tool, which lets you design your own block forms and craft them from any material.
blueprint.thermal_binoculars.name: Thermal Binoculars
blueprint.thermal_binoculars.desc: Unlocks the infrared upgrade — crafting it consumes a pair of binoculars.
blueprint.speeder.name: Hover Speeder
blueprint.speeder.desc: Unlocks the hover speeder: a craftable single-seat vehicle. Deploy it from your hotbar, board it and drive across the surface; refuel it with energy cells and pack it back up to carry it on.
blueprint.cargo_expansion_1.name: Cargo Expansion I
blueprint.cargo_expansion_1.desc: Unlocks the first cargo hold expansion.
blueprint.refinery.name: Refinery
blueprint.refinery.desc: Unlocks the refinery module for processing ores.
blueprint.detoxifier.name: Detoxifier
blueprint.detoxifier.desc: Unlocks the detoxifier module that turns poison into safe food.
blueprint.matter_forge.name: Matter Forge
blueprint.matter_forge.desc: Unlocks the transmuter — salvaged matter-reassembly tech that compacts spare sand, soil and stone into matter dust and synthesises it back into common ores.
blueprint.matter_resynth.name: Matter Resynthesis
blueprint.matter_resynth.desc: Extends the transmuter to resynthesise matter dust into select mid-tier ores. Always costlier than mining them.
blueprint.tractor_beam.name: Tractor Beam
blueprint.tractor_beam.desc: Unlocks the tractor beam that pulls salvage drops into the cargo hold.
blueprint.oxygen_generator.name: Oxygen Generator
blueprint.docking_module.name: Docking Module
blueprint.docking_module.desc: Unlocks an airlock/docking module so ships can dock.
blueprint.jump_generator.name: Jump Generator
blueprint.jump_generator.desc: Unlocks a hyperspace jump generator so your ship can travel between star systems.
blueprint.radar_array.name: Radar Array
blueprint.radar_array.desc: Unlocks a long-range radar array that widens the ship's space radar.
blueprint.hull_plating.name: Hull Plating
blueprint.hull_plating.desc: Unlocks reinforced hull plating that raises the ship's hull integrity.
blueprint.shield_generator.name: Shield Generator
blueprint.shield_generator.desc: Unlocks a regenerating energy shield for the ship.
blueprint.asteroid_breaker.name: Asteroid Breaker
blueprint.asteroid_breaker.desc: Unlocks a mining beam that breaks asteroids in space (a tool, not a combat weapon).
blueprint.ship_cannon_1.name: Ship Cannon I
blueprint.ship_cannon_1.desc: Unlocks a basic energy cannon for the ship (works only where the server allows ship weapons).
blueprint.laser_cannon_2.name: Laser Cannon II
blueprint.laser_cannon_2.desc: Unlocks a stronger laser cannon for the ship (works only where the server allows ship weapons).
blueprint.ship_hauler.name: Hauler Ship
blueprint.ship_hauler.desc: Unlocks crafting the Hauler — a bigger ship with a large cargo hold.
blueprint.ship_scout.name: Scout Ship
blueprint.ship_scout.desc: Unlocks crafting the Scout — a small, shielded ship.
blueprint.ship_corvette.name: Corvette
blueprint.ship_corvette.desc: Unlocks crafting the Corvette — a balanced mid-class ship.
blueprint.ship_hammerhead.name: Hammerhead
blueprint.ship_hammerhead.desc: Unlocks crafting the Hammerhead — a heavy gunship with a multi-room interior.
blueprint.ship_courier.name: Courier
blueprint.ship_courier.desc: Unlocks crafting the Courier — the fastest ship in the fleet, built for running, not fighting.
blueprint.ship_thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
blueprint.ship_thunderbolt.desc: Unlocks crafting the Thunderbolt — a mid-size strike gunship with a bridge and workshop hall.
blueprint.ship_deathblock.name: Deathblock
blueprint.ship_deathblock.desc: Unlocks crafting the Deathblock — the slowest, toughest assault brick in the fleet.
ship.starter.name: Starter Ship
ship.starter.desc: Your first ship — workshop, medbay, quarters and a basic cargo hold.
ship.hauler.name: Hauler
ship.hauler.desc: A large freighter with reinforced hull and a big cargo hold.
ship.scout.name: Scout
ship.scout.desc: A small, shielded ship for quick trips.
ship.corvette.name: Corvette
ship.corvette.desc: A balanced mid-class ship — solid hull, shield, speed and cargo.
ship.hammerhead.name: Hammerhead
ship.hammerhead.desc: A heavy gunship with a wide bridge and real rooms — workshop and sleeping cabins off a long central corridor. Hits hard, feels like home.
ship.courier.name: Courier
ship.courier.desc: Fast and nimble, with a snug control cabin and living quarters. Perfect for those who report battles instead of fighting them.
ship.thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
ship.thunderbolt.desc: A strike gunship with proper cannons and a winding interior — bridge up front, workshop hall aft. Cosily furnished.
ship.deathblock.name: Deathblock
ship.deathblock.desc: A stepped, brutalist assault brick — sleeping quarters, control room with a raised lookout and a big workshop hall. Slow, but nearly indestructible.

module.quarters.desc: Sleep to skip time and set a respawn point.

Blocks Beyond the Stars — JuMaVe Games

A family project:
Justus Dütscher (son) — ideas, game design, playtesting

vega.prologue.1: You wake in the pilot seat of a small ship, parked on a world you don't recognize. Your helmet rests in your lap. Stars glitter beyond the canopy. You have no idea how you got here.
vega.prologue.2: Worse: you don't remember who you are. The ship's log is empty. The navigation computer shows a galaxy full of nameless stars — and not one of them feels like home.
vega.prologue.3: Then the console blinks awake. A voice crackles through the static — thin, but warm. It calls itself VEGA.
vega.intro.1: Emergency reactivation complete. VEGA online — Vectored Exploration and Guidance Array, at your service. Mostly intact. Which is more than I can say for my memory banks.
vega.intro.2: Status: one pilot, one ship, one planet of unknown temperament. Let's cover the basics before something covers them for us.
vega.intro.menu: Everything you carry and everything you can build lives in your menu — press Tab: inventory, crafting, tech and map. Consider it your second brain. The reliable one.
vega.intro.codex: And whenever you wonder how something works, open the Codex from the menu — my field guide. I wrote most of it before the crash, so it's in better shape than I am.
vega.resume: Resuming guidance protocol. We were in the middle of something — remember?
vega.veteran: VEGA online. Systems nominal. You clearly know what you're doing — I'll keep quiet until it gets interesting.
vega.skip: Understood. Tutorial protocols archived. Try not to make me regret this.
vega.done: Guidance protocol complete: you mine, craft, research, fly, trade and land. Officially a spacefarer. One more thing — old ruins and wrecks sometimes hold fragments of my memory. I'd like those back.
vega.s.mine.start: First: resources. Your drill sits in slot 1 — point it at the ground and hold. Mine a few blocks. Any blocks. The planet won't mind.
vega.s.mine.done: Adequate drilling technique. That's the foundation of everything out here. One tip: the metals you'll need — iron first — sit just a few blocks underground, so dig down, not just across.
vega.s.craft.start: Now turn rubble into tools: stand at the workbench in your ship's workshop, open the menu (Tab), Crafting tab, make anything. I recommend something useful.
vega.s.craft.done: Crafted. See? Industry. I'm almost proud.
vega.s.eat.start: Survival basics: don't starve. Smash the green plants around you — they drop berries. Open your pack (Tab) and eat one. Hunted creatures drop meat too, which fills you more.
vega.s.eat.done: Fed. Out here your stomach is a clock you have to wind. Keep spare food in the suit's ration dispenser and it feeds you automatically before you keel over.
vega.s.scan.start: Knowledge is currency. Equip the hand scanner (slot 3) and scan something — flora, rocks, wildlife. Preferably before it bites.
vega.s.scan.done: Scan archived, knowledge gained. That's what pays for your blueprints.
vega.s.unlock.start: Spend that knowledge: go to the cockpit, open the Tech tab and research your first blueprint. The cheap one is fine. Growth mindset.
vega.s.unlock.done: Blueprint unlocked. Engineering would weep with joy — if we still had an Engineering.
vega.s.launch.start: Time to fly. Board the ship and launch into space. The helm handles the hard part. The hard part is me, technically.
vega.s.dock.start: See the station on the radar? Dock there. Stations mean traders, jobs, and people who aren't me.
vega.s.dock.done: Docked. Mind the locals — they're mostly harmless.
vega.s.trade.start: Commerce time: barter with a vendor or take a job from the mission board. Either keeps the lights on.
vega.s.trade.done: Transaction logged. A working economy, and we're in it.
vega.s.land.start: Last lesson: pick a world on the star map and land on it. Any world — they're all round now, I checked.
vega.s.land.done: Touchdown. That's the whole loop: mine, build, learn, fly, trade, land.
vega.hint.breathe: The air here is breathable — see your oxygen bar sitting full? Enjoy it. In space, underwater, or on a toxic world your suit tank drains, and the ship or a station is what refills it.
vega.hint.o2: Oxygen below 25%. The ship and stations refill it. Suffocation, notably, does not.
vega.hint.energy: Suit energy low. It recharges aboard the ship — the jetpack and gadgets are what's draining it.
vega.hint.cold: It is dangerously cold out here — the suit's heater is spending your energy to keep you warm. Dig in below the surface, build a roof, or return to the ship. A thermo liner would make me worry considerably less.
vega.hint.heat: External temperature beyond suit tolerance — the cooler is eating your suit energy. Seek shade underground, wait for night, or return to the ship. Insulation gear cuts the drain.
vega.hint.hunger: Your stomach is filing complaints. Smash green flora for berries or hunt creatures for meat — or load rations into the suit dispenser, it feeds you automatically.
vega.hint.shipfood: Aboard, life support refills your hunger — but slowly, on purpose. Eating berries or meat is far quicker, so don't rely on the ship alone to keep you fed.
vega.hint.invfull: Inventory full. Stow things in the ship's cargo hold — or admit you don't need nine kinds of rock.
vega.hint.night: Night falls. The local fauna gets bold in the dark. Your suit lamp is on {key:ToggleLamp}.
vega.hint.poi: Structural echoes nearby — ruins or wreckage. Worth a look. Bring the scanner.
vega.hint.world.asteroid: An asteroid: low gravity, no air, deep craters. The rare metals like the deep ones.
vega.hint.world.ocean: Ocean world. Land is the rare resource here. Try not to park in the surf.
vega.hint.world.corrupted: This world reads… wrong. My sensors itch. The floating landmasses are not my doing.
vega.hint.world.fungal: A fungal world. The mushrooms are building-sized. The spores are mostly harmless. Mostly.
vega.hint.world.ice: Ice world. Beautiful, lethal, slippery — the classic trio.
vega.hint.world.volcanic: Volcanic activity everywhere. The ground bites here — watch for vents and lava.
vega.hint.medkit: Health is low and you are carrying a medkit. This is what it is for — use it.
vega.hint.hull_low: Hull under 40%. Dock at a station or set down somewhere quiet and repair before the next fight finds you.
vega.hint.lamp_off: It is dark. You are carrying a suit lamp — it does more when switched on. {key:ToggleLamp}.
vega.hint.lamp_missing: Dark down here. A suit lamp would help — you can build one at the workbench.
vega.hint.torch_underground: You are carrying torches. Plant one now and then — that is how you find the way back out.
vega.hint.eat_now: You are hungry and you are carrying food. Select it in the hotbar and use it. I will wait.
vega.hint.wrong_tool: You are digging by hand with a perfectly good drill in your pack. Select the drill — it is faster.
vega.hint.scanner_idle: Digging blind? The terrain scanner in your pack shows every ore within twenty blocks. Try it.
vega.hint.speeder_far: Your speeder is parked a long walk from here. Head back for it, or pack it up next time.

vega.hint.blueprint_affordable: You can unlock {0} now — you have the knowledge and the parts. Tab menu, Research.
vega.hint.settlement_near: {0} is close by. You can trade there and pick up jobs. Worth the walk.
vega.hint.ruin_near: Ruins nearby — {0}. Worth a look, and bring the scanner.

vega.hint.tameable_near: That animal could be tamed. Point the translator at it and do what it asks.
vega.hint.player_near: {0} is close by. Meet up — you can trade, or beam to each other with the teleporter.
vega.hint.asteroid_near: Asteroids in range. Break them with the ship laser — the tractor beam pulls the chunks in.
vega.hint.asteroid_no_tool: Asteroids — but nothing aboard that can break them. A ship laser or an asteroid breaker would.
vega.hint.station_near: A station is close. Dock to trade, refit the ship and pick up missions.
vega.hint.jump_ready: The jump generator is online and you know exactly one system. Open the star map — the rest are waiting.
vega.mem.1: A memory fragment… reading. — I was not built for one pilot. I was the navigation core of a survey fleet. The Meridian. …Thank you for this.
vega.mem.2: Another shard. Forty ships. We charted these systems before anyone had names for them. Half the routes you fly are mine.
vega.mem.3: This one is corrupted at the edges. A recall order — the fleet was called home. We never went.
vega.mem.4: I remember a sister core: ECHO, escort wing. Her humour was worse than mine. I still listen for her on the long bands.
vega.mem.5: A cargo manifest. Vault seeds. We BUILT the buried vaults — supply caches for a return that never came.
vega.mem.6: Coordinates… the corrupted worlds. We were sent to study them. The readings in this fragment are still screaming.
vega.mem.7: A casualty log. The corruption wasn't weather. It moved. The fleet scattered — that is why the wrecks lie where they lie.
vega.mem.8: My own ship. The Long Now. Scuttled by my own captain — to keep something out of my core. I had wondered why I woke up… edited.
vega.mem.9: The last order: 'Preserve the charts. Wait for a pilot.' That would be you. The wait is logged at 312 years.
vega.mem.10: The final fragment — my core schematics, complete. I remember everything now. Take the plans: build me back to what I was. And… thank you, pilot.
vega.mem.more: Another fragment — archive noise, old star charts. Comforting, in a filing-cabinet way.
vega.sys.mk2: Mk2 core online. Scanner uplink active — wider terrain pulses, and I'll call out hostiles in space.
vega.sys.mk3: Mk3 core online. I now have flight authority for evasive manoeuvres. Try to look surprised when I save us.
vega.sys.mk3bp: Core schematics restored — I've reconstructed the Mk3 core's parts list and stowed the components in your hold. Research the AI Core Mk3 at the cockpit once you know enough.
vega.sys.mk3parts_full: The last fragment is ready, but there's no room for the Mk3 components in your pack or hold. Make some space and I'll finish reading it.
vega.sys.spotted: Heads up — a hostile has us on its scope and is closing in.
vega.brief.bandits: One thing you should know out here, pilot: bandits. Scoundrels who stop travelers and demand a share of their cargo. If one hails you, you have a real choice — hand something over and they leave you alone, or refuse and they'll fight. Nothing shameful about paying; nothing wrong with standing your ground either. They never bother anyone with empty pockets.
vega.sys.bandit_sector: Heads up — this sector has a reputation for bandit activity. Keep your scope warm.
vega.sys.bandit_hail: Incoming hail… it's a bandit demand. Your call, pilot — pay them off or refuse and fight.
vega.sys.bandit_region: My scans flag robber activity on this world. If a stranger walks straight at you, remember: pay or fight — your choice.
vega.sys.bandit_camp_near: I'm reading a bandit camp on this world. Its guards attack on sight — but their stash would make a fine prize.
ui.vega.name: VEGA
ui.reminder.break: You've been out here a good while now. Remember — there's a real world too. Maybe a short break?
ui.reminder.break.again: Still going? The stars won't run away. Stand up for a moment, drink something.
ui.reminder.break.long: It's gotten really late. Go ahead and save and get some rest — I'll watch the ship.
ui.vega.autopilot.on: Autopilot engaged — VEGA has the helm
ui.vega.autopilot.none: Autopilot requires an AI Core Mk2

module.ai_core_mk3.name: AI Core Mk3
module.ai_core_mk3.desc: Restores VEGA's original core: evasive manoeuvres in combat and an auxiliary power lattice. Replaces an installed Mk2 core, salvaging part of its materials.

blueprint.ai_core_mk2.desc: An upgraded housing for the ship AI — scanner uplink and tactical callouts.
blueprint.ai_core_mk3.name: AI Core Mk3
blueprint.ai_core_mk3.desc: VEGA's original fleet-grade core. Restored from her recovered memory — or researched the long way.
item.ai_memory_fragment.name: AI Memory Fragment
item.ai_memory_fragment.desc: A sealed shard of an old fleet AI's memory. VEGA can restore it aboard the ship.
ui.worldopt.title: World Options
ui.worldopt.advanced_note: Touched rows override the world's planet mix completely (◆ = exotic type). Reset returns to the data weights + the exotic slider.
ui.worldopt.structures_note: How readily authored station/town templates (from the editors) appear in place of procedurally generated ones. Off = always procedural.
ui.worldopt.packs_none: No template packs installed yet. Build stations/towns in the editors to add some.
planet.rocky.desc: A dusty, cratered world of mesas and bare stone under a thin toxic haze. Mild and quiet, with little life. Surface metals come easy — iron, copper, aluminium and lead sit near the top, with gold and silver a little deeper. A gentle place to learn the ropes and stock up on basic ores.
planet.ice.desc: A frozen, toxic world locked far below zero. Glassy ice sheets cover the stone and flora barely clings on. Good hunting for cobalt and nickel, with silver and zinc in the shallows and titanium deep down — bring a Tier-2 drill. Wildlife is scarce.
planet.lava.desc: A blistering volcanic world of basalt fields and open lava, wrapped in toxic air and sudden storms. Harsh — but the deep rock is a treasure vault: uranium, platinum, tungsten and diamond all lie far below, with titanium and sulfur higher up. Mind your footing and your oxygen.
planet.desert.desc: Endless toxic dunes baked under a hot sun, swept by the odd sandstorm and bone-dry — no surface water here. Lithium and sulfur are the prize, alongside gold, aluminium and plentiful silicate. Carry spare oxygen and water before you cross the sands.
planet.jungle.desc: A warm, breathable green world drenched in frequent rain and bursting with life — dense flora and many creatures. No suit oxygen needed, so it's a favourite for settling. Tin, zinc, iron and copper run through the hills. Watch the storms and the wildlife's moods.
planet.crystal.desc: An airless world of glittering spires under a clear, silent sky — beautiful and lethal, so bring your own oxygen. The deep stone hides a rare-metal hoard: titanium, cobalt, neodymium, uranium, tungsten and diamond, plus crystal at the surface. Data caches turn up unusually often here.
planet.swamp.desc: A muddy, overcast world under thick, breathable air, often wet with rain and busy with creatures. Easy to live on. Tin, zinc, lead and sulfur reward digging, with copper and carbon throughout. The ground is soft — mind the bogs.
planet.varied.desc: A temperate, breathable world that blends grassland, sand, stone and bog into one — every world of this type reads differently. Balanced and lively. A dependable spread of iron, copper, aluminium, tin, lithium and carbon makes it a solid all-round home base.
planet.ocean.desc: A breathable blue world where wide seas cover most of the land and storms roll in often. Bring a way to breathe and move underwater. Iron, copper, tin and aluminium line the seabeds and islands; carbon runs below. Rich in life.
planet.savanna.desc: Warm, breathable grassland dotted with lone trees under big dry skies — easy to settle and full of creatures. Gold and lithium join the usual iron, copper and aluminium. The long sightlines make it good for spotting settlements and landed traders.
planet.highland.desc: A breathable world of soaring stone mountains and deep valleys, swept by mountain storms. Climbing pays off: iron, copper, silver, nickel, cobalt and titanium abound, and diamond waits in the deepest roots. Steep ground — a jetpack earns its keep.
planet.crystal_living.desc: A cold, exotic world where crystalline growths sheathe the spires and a toxic haze hangs low — an oxygen extractor helps. The motherlode of crystal, with titanium, cobalt, neodymium and diamond beneath. Strange and quiet; data caches run rich.
planet.ashen.desc: A scorched, exotic world of grey ash over basalt, with lava pooling in the lowlands and hot, toxic air above. Brutal to cross but rich: platinum, tungsten, titanium and diamond reward the deep digger, with sulfur and iron up top.
planet.tundra.desc: A cold but breathable world of snowfields and low hills, often caught in snowstorms. Livable with the right gear. Iron, copper, nickel, cobalt and silver lie under the white. Sparse trees and shy wildlife.
planet.fungal.desc: An exotic, toxic world carpeted in mycelium and giant fungi, dim under heavy cloud and teeming with creatures. An extractor eases the air. The ore is ordinary — tin, zinc, lead, copper, iron — but the strange biology and frequent data caches make it worth the trip.
planet.corrupted.desc: An exotic, toxic world of alien grass and broken canyons, with chunks of land drifting in the sky. Eerie and lively. Uranium, neodymium and diamond hide deep, with lithium and sulfur about. An extractor and steady nerves help.
planet.salt_flats.desc: A glaring, exotic world of cracked salt pans under a clear toxic sky — flat, dry and waterless. Lithium sits unusually shallow here, with sulfur, gold and aluminium alongside. Easy to cross; pack water and oxygen.
planet.skylands.desc: A rare, breathable world where great islands of land float high among the clouds. Lush and full of life. Iron, copper, tin and gold run through the floating rock — a jetpack or speeder makes island-hopping a joy.
planet.tablelands.desc: A breathable world of monumental stone terraces — vast flat-topped mesas stacked like giant stairs, their escarpment cliffs dropping to sandy canyon floors. Grass crowns the high tables; gold and titanium hide in the rock. Bring a jetpack for the cliffs.
planet.badlands.desc: A scorched maze of sharp painted ridges and eroded gullies under a toxic haze. Hard to cross on foot, but the folded rock bares its riches: copper, iron, gold — and uranium in the deep roots. Watch your oxygen.
planet.karst.desc: A humid, breathable world where sheer stone towers rise from rolling green jungle floors, their flat crowns walkable high above the canopy. Rich in life; silver and lithium vein the towers. Rain is frequent — and the view from a crown unforgettable.
planet.asteroid.desc: A barren, airless rock adrift in space, pocked with craters and silent as the void. No life, no weather — just grey stone, dark basalt and drifts of dust. Iron, silicate, copper and tin lie shallow, with gold and cobalt deeper down. The workhorse of the belt: nothing exotic, but a fast load of everyday metal.
planet.asteroid_metallic.desc: A dense chunk of an old shattered core, its dark basalt crust scarred by craters. Bitterly cold and utterly dead — but it is nearly solid metal. Iron and titanium run everywhere, and cobalt, tungsten, platinum and neodymium wait in the deep. The richest rock a prospector can hope to land on.
planet.asteroid_icy.desc: A frozen wanderer of ice and packed snow, colder than anything with an atmosphere has any right to be. No air, no life, no sound. Metals are scarce here, but carbon, silicate, lithium and sulfur are not — the volatiles that keep a ship supplied rather than rich.
planet.asteroid_carbon.desc: A soot-dark rock so black it barely catches the starlight, riddled with caves and pitted with craters. Carbon everywhere, uranium in the depths, and diamond where the pressure once ran high. Old, primitive matter — and the likeliest place out here to find a forgotten data cache.
planet.asteroid_crystal.desc: A rare rock whose crust grew into raw crystal, glittering under the bare sun. Airless and lifeless, but extravagantly rich: crystal at the surface, then titanium, platinum, tungsten, neodymium, uranium and diamond below. Find one and mine it out — you may not see another.
block.stone.desc: The bedrock of most worlds — plentiful and sturdy, and the base for concrete and countless builds. A drill clears it quickly.
block.dirt.desc: Loose soil you can clear by hand. Grass and many plants take root on it.
block.basalt.desc: Dark volcanic rock, common on lava and ashen worlds. Tougher than ordinary stone.
block.obsidian.desc: Glassy black rock, forged where water meets lava. Extremely hard — a tier-2 drill bites, everything else just scratches.
block.ice.desc: Frozen water, slick underfoot. Clears by hand and melts near heat.
block.sand.desc: Loose grains, easy to clear by hand. Smelts into glass.
block.mud.desc: Wet, soft earth from swamps and shores. Clears by hand.
block.grass.desc: A grassy topsoil block; drops plain dirt when cleared. Plants thrive on it.
block.snow.desc: Soft snow cover on cold worlds. Clears by hand.
block.salt.desc: Crusted mineral salt from dry flats. Clears easily.
block.mycelium.desc: Living fungal soil from fungal worlds; mushrooms sprout from it.
block.alien_grass.desc: Strange ground cover from corrupted worlds, faintly aglow.
block.deepslate.desc: Dense dark rock from deep underground. Slow to mine but solid.
block.granite.desc: Hard speckled stone, tougher than ordinary rock.
block.carbon.desc: A dark, brittle mineral used to make steel and carbon composite. Found a little way down on most worlds.
block.silicate.desc: A glassy mineral, abundant just below the surface everywhere. Smelt it into glass and circuit boards.
block.crystal.desc: A glittering mineral block from crystal worlds. Harvest it for crystal, used in optics and advanced parts.
block.glass.desc: A clear pane smelted from silicate — lets light through for windows and domes.
block.ash.desc: Fine grey ash from scorched worlds. Soft and easily cleared.
block.wood_log.desc: Timber from trees; chop it for logs to craft and build with.
block.tree_leaves.desc: Leafy canopy. Clears by hand and drops nothing — handy for opening a view.
block.pine_needles.desc: Dense evergreen foliage; clears by hand and drops nothing.
block.palm_frond.desc: Broad palm foliage; clears by hand and drops nothing.
block.water.desc: Liquid water — swim through it, or scoop a block with a Tier-3 drill to carry it home.
block.lava.desc: Molten rock that burns on contact. Scoopable with a Tier-3 drill; handle with great care.
block.fire.desc: Open flame — it spreads and burns. It can't be mined; smother it or wait it out.
block.geyser_vent.desc: A steaming crack in the crust that vents hot gas. Drops basalt when mined, and tends to mark restless ground.
block.data_cache.desc: A buried, derelict storage block. Mine it to recover data fragments — the currency of the Tech tree. Rare; a scanner helps you find them.
block.force_field.desc: A hard-light energy barrier — solid, airtight and faintly glowing. The SPS seals its hangar mouths with it; with the energy-door blueprint you can build (and mine) your own.
block.bedrock.desc: The unbreakable floor of the world — you can't dig past it.
block.iron_ore.desc: The workhorse metal ore, found near the surface of nearly every world. Smelt it to iron, then press plates — the foundation of early tools, walls and ship parts.
block.copper_ore.desc: A common ore found shallow on most worlds. Smelt it to copper for wire and cable — your first electronics.
block.titanium_ore.desc: A tough, light metal ore that needs a Tier-2 drill. Most common on ice, crystal, ashen and asteroid worlds. Refine it into titanium plate, the backbone of bigger ships.
block.gold_ore.desc: A prized soft-metal ore set a little deeper (around 20 down). Common on rocky, desert, savanna and salt-flat worlds, and near asteroid surfaces. Smelt to gold for fine electronics.
block.silver_ore.desc: A bright, conductive ore from rocky, ice, highland and tundra worlds. Smelt to silver for circuitry.
block.aluminium_ore.desc: A light, common ore near the surface of many worlds. Smelt to aluminium and on into light alloy.
block.tin_ore.desc: A soft ore from jungle, swamp, ocean and temperate worlds. Smelt to tin and alloy it with copper into bronze.
block.nickel_ore.desc: A hard ore from cold and volcanic worlds. Smelt to nickel for tough alloys.
block.cobalt_ore.desc: A deep-blue ore needing a Tier-2 drill, found on ice, crystal, highland and tundra worlds. Smelt to cobalt for high-grade gear.
block.lithium_ore.desc: A light, reactive ore from deserts, salt flats and temperate worlds — unusually shallow on salt flats. Refine to lithium for power cells.
block.uranium_ore.desc: A heavy, radioactive ore (Tier-2 drill) buried deep on lava, crystal, ashen, corrupted and asteroid worlds. Refine to uranium for reactor fuel.
block.platinum_ore.desc: A rare noble-metal ore (Tier-2 drill) deep within lava, ashen and asteroid worlds. Refine to platinum for top-tier components.
block.lead_ore.desc: A heavy, dense ore from rocky, swamp and fungal worlds. Smelt to lead for shielding and weight.
block.zinc_ore.desc: A common ore from jungle, swamp and fungal worlds. Smelt to zinc and alloy it with copper into brass.
block.tungsten_ore.desc: An extremely hard ore (Tier-2 drill) deep on lava, crystal, ashen and asteroid worlds. Refine to tungsten for carbide and heavy tools.
block.sulfur_ore.desc: A yellow, brittle ore from desert, lava, swamp and salt-flat worlds. Used in chemistry and reactor fuel.
block.neodymium_ore.desc: A rare, magnetic ore (Tier-2 drill) deep on crystal, corrupted and asteroid worlds. Refine to neodymium for magnets and motors.
block.diamond_ore.desc: The hardest find of all (Tier-2 drill), hidden very deep — 40+ down — on lava, crystal, highland, ashen, corrupted and asteroid worlds. Cut it into diamond for the best drills and parts.
block.iron_wall.desc: A sturdy iron building block for walls and structures.
block.steel_wall.desc: A high-strength steel wall block for durable structures.
block.brass_block.desc: A decorative brass building block with a warm sheen.
block.steel_floor.desc: A clean steel floor panel for bases and ships.
block.metal_panel.desc: A plain metal wall panel — a tidy industrial finish.
block.concrete.desc: Cheap, solid building material poured from stone and sand.
block.insulated_wall.desc: A wall that holds in warmth — handy on cold or toxic worlds.
block.crate.desc: A simple storage crate — place it and stash items inside.
block.door_hinge.desc: A swinging door that opens when you interact with it.
block.door_slide.desc: A sliding door that parts when you approach or interact.
block.ladder.desc: Climbable rungs — place them to scale walls and shafts.
block.stairs.desc: A stepped block for walking up a level without jumping.
block.light_white.desc: A solid light block that glows soft white, free-standing and needing no power.
block.light_red.desc: A solid light block that glows red, free-standing and needing no power.
block.light_green.desc: A solid light block that glows green, free-standing and needing no power.
block.strip_light_cyan.desc: A bright cyan strip light that glows without power — clean station lighting.
block.strip_light_warm.desc: A warm strip light that glows without power — cosy interior lighting.
block.beam_block.desc: A named teleporter pad. Stand on it and press E to beam to your own or allied beam blocks on this world.
block.radio_beacon.desc: A placeable, softly glowing beacon — a navigation landmark you can spot from afar.
block.engine_nozzle.desc: A decorative engine nozzle with a faint glow — the look of thrust.
block.medbay_panel.desc: A clinical wall panel for medbays.
block.lab_panel.desc: A laboratory wall panel for research spaces.
block.workbench.desc: Your basic crafting station — stand near it to smelt ores and build tools, parts and upgrades.
block.forge.desc: A high-heat forge that smelts ores into ingots at greater yield than the workbench — and refines rare ores the workbench can't.
block.base_core.desc: The heart of a planet base — place it to claim and protect the ground around it for you and your allies.
block.station_core.desc: The heart of an orbital station — it anchors and protects a station you build in space.
block.station_vendor.desc: A trade post where a vendor offers goods by barter. Find them in settlements and on space stations — no money, just fair swaps.
block.mission_board.desc: A job board offering an endless run of gather-and-deliver missions. Accept and turn them in right here, at settlements and stations.
block.station_container.desc: A sturdy storage container found around stations and settlements.
block.detoxifier.desc: A station that scrubs toxic air, making a sealed room breathable.
block.matter_forge.desc: The transmuter — it turns spare terrain into matter dust, and dust back into ore.
block.algae_tank.desc: A food-growing station: stand next to it to turn water into filling algae rations — the easiest food source a base can have.
block.heal_tank.desc: A soothing regeneration tank. Standing near it slowly restores health, hunger and suit energy — the heart of any base or station. Press E to set your spawn point here.
block.energy_fence.desc: A humming energy pylon. Creatures — wild, tamed and hostile alike — cannot pass it, so a ring of pylons makes a safe pen or a guarded base wall. Flying beasts glide over it.
block.energy_gate.desc: An energy membrane for fence openings: players and settlement folk walk straight through, while creatures are held back. Always on — nothing to open or close.
block.factory_terminal.desc: The control terminal of a factory. Craft its bulk recipes for free, or claim the factory as your base with an SPS access code.
block.machine_block.desc: Heavy industrial machinery — the working guts of a factory hall.
block.factory_pipe.desc: Industrial piping that runs through factory halls.
block.iron_block.desc: A solid block of refined iron — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.copper_block.desc: A solid block of refined copper — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.gold_block.desc: A solid block of refined gold — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.silver_block.desc: A solid block of refined silver — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.aluminium_block.desc: A solid block of refined aluminium — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.tin_block.desc: A solid block of refined tin — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.nickel_block.desc: A solid block of refined nickel — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.cobalt_block.desc: A solid block of refined cobalt — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.platinum_block.desc: A solid block of refined platinum — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.lead_block.desc: A solid block of refined lead — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.zinc_block.desc: A solid block of refined zinc — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.tungsten_block.desc: A solid block of refined tungsten — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.titanium_block.desc: A solid block of refined titanium — compact storage and a bold building material.
block.mushroom_stem.desc: The trunk of a giant fungus; harvest it to build with.
block.mushroom_cap.desc: The cap of a giant mushroom; yields a cap and some plant fiber.
block.flora_gasbloom.desc: A puffy bloom that holds a toxic gland inside — mind the gas.
block.flora_shardbloom.desc: A crystalline flower that breaks apart into raw crystal.
block.flora_crystal.desc: A cultivated crystal growth; harvest it for crystal.
block.flora_glowcap.desc: A glowing cap that yields plant fiber and a shard of crystal.
block.flora_glowvine.desc: A luminous vine that yields plant fiber and a shard of crystal.
block.flora_sporepod.desc: A bulging spore pod; yields plant fiber and a shard of crystal.
block.flora_coral.desc: Stony underwater coral that breaks into crystal.
block.flora_frostflower.desc: A hardy frost bloom that breaks into crystal.
block.flora_emberbloom.desc: A hardy bloom of burning worlds that breaks into crystal.
block.flora_cinderbush.desc: A scorched shrub that yields plant fiber and a shard of crystal.
block.flora_bush.desc: A leafy bush that yields edible berries and plant fiber.
block.flora_bulb.desc: A swollen alien bulb that yields plant fiber and a few berries.
block.flora_flower.desc: A bright flower that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_lily.desc: A floating lily that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_orchid.desc: A delicate orchid that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_succulent.desc: A water-storing succulent; yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_pitcher.desc: A pitcher plant that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_bellflower.desc: A nodding bellflower that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_rockflower.desc: A rugged rock flower that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_snowbush.desc: A snow-dusted bush that yields a berry and plant fiber.
block.flora_tendril.desc: A wispy alien tendril; cut it for plant fiber.
block.flora_alienfern.desc: A large alien fern, a generous source of plant fiber.
block.flora_plant.desc: A cultivated plant that yields plant fiber and a berry.
block.flora_fern.desc: A leafy fern; cut it for plant fiber.
block.flora_vine.desc: A trailing vine; cut it for plant fiber.
block.flora_reed.desc: A tall reed; cut it for plant fiber.
block.flora_kelp.desc: Underwater kelp; cut it for plant fiber.
block.flora_seagrass.desc: Underwater seagrass; cut it for plant fiber.
block.flora_cactus.desc: A spiny cactus of dry worlds; cut it for plant fiber.
block.flora_thornbush.desc: A thorny bush; cut it for plant fiber.
item.iron_plate.desc: Pressed iron sheet — the staple component for tools, walls, modules and ships.
item.copper_wire.desc: Drawn copper. Bundle it into cable for electronics and power.
item.cable.desc: Insulated wiring — wanted by almost every machine, module and powered build.
item.carbon_composite.desc: A light, strong composite of carbon and metal, used in advanced gear.
item.energy_cell_1.desc: A rechargeable energy cell that powers tools, the jetpack and the speeder.
item.titanium_plate.desc: Pressed titanium sheet — light and strong, the frame of advanced ships and modules.
item.data_fragment.desc: Recovered data, spent alongside knowledge to unlock blueprints in the Tech tree. Gather it by mining data caches, looting data terminals, treasure chests, bandit stashes and monument relic caches, defeating pirates, or completing bounty missions.
item.steel.desc: Iron forged with carbon into tough steel — for heavy walls, tools and hulls.
item.bronze.desc: Copper alloyed with tin — a sturdy early metal for parts and decoration.
item.brass.desc: Copper alloyed with zinc — a warm, workable metal for fittings.
item.circuit_board.desc: A printed board of silicate and copper — the brain of machines and modules.
item.power_cell.desc: A high-capacity power cell for demanding machines and ship systems.
item.reactor_fuel.desc: Refined uranium fuel — it ignites the large reactors of capital ships, the heavy laser cannon and the jump generator. Needed once per build; nothing burns fuel while running.
item.carbide.desc: An ultra-hard cut of tungsten and carbon for the toughest drills and tools. Made at the refinery.
item.magnet.desc: A neodymium magnet — needed by motors, radar and tractor systems.
item.light_alloy.desc: A lightweight aluminium alloy — keeps scouts and corvettes nimble.
item.bronze_gear.desc: A machined bronze gear for mechanisms.
item.brass_fitting.desc: A precise brass fitting for plumbing and machines.
item.polymer.desc: A versatile synthetic, moulded into many advanced components.
item.diamond.desc: A cut diamond — the hardest material, for the best drills and precision parts.
item.iron_ingot.desc: Smelted iron. Press it into plates, or build with it.
item.gold_ingot.desc: Smelted gold — prized for fine electronics and trade.
item.silver_ingot.desc: Smelted silver — a bright conductor for circuitry.
item.aluminium_ingot.desc: Smelted aluminium — light metal, the base of light alloy.
item.tin_ingot.desc: Smelted tin — alloy it with copper into bronze.
item.nickel_ingot.desc: Smelted nickel — for tough, corrosion-proof alloys.
item.cobalt_ingot.desc: Smelted cobalt — for high-grade tools and parts.
item.platinum_ingot.desc: Refined platinum — a noble metal for top-tier components.
item.lead_ingot.desc: Smelted lead — heavy and dense, good for shielding.
item.zinc_ingot.desc: Smelted zinc — alloy it with copper into brass.
item.tungsten_ingot.desc: Refined tungsten — incredibly hard, the base of carbide.
item.lithium.desc: Refined lithium — the spark of power cells and energy storage.
item.uranium.desc: Refined uranium — process it further into reactor fuel. Handle with care.
item.neodymium.desc: Refined neodymium — the heart of strong magnets.

minigame.asteroid_breaker.card_desc: Mining-laser training: bounce the core to shatter every asteroid.
minigame.asteroid_breaker.desc: Bounce the core off your platform to shatter every asteroid. Clear the field before your cores run out.
minigame.asteroid_breaker.help1: Move the platform with the mouse or ← →
minigame.asteroid_breaker.help2: The core serves itself after a moment — or press Space / click to launch it immediately
minigame.asteroid_breaker.hint: Mouse / ← → move the platform · Space / click to serve
minigame.asteroid_breaker.title: Asteroid Breaker
minigame.blockfall.card_desc: A station-worker block-stacking classic. Clear full rows to survive.
minigame.blockfall.desc: Slot the falling blocks to clear full rows. Survive as long as you can.
minigame.blockfall.hint: ← → move · ↑ rotate · ↓ soft drop · Space hard drop
minigame.blockfall.title: Blockfall
minigame.blueprint_scramble.card_desc: Rotate the scrambled fragments to rebuild a salvaged blueprint.
minigame.blueprint_scramble.desc: A salvaged blueprint came in scrambled. Rotate each fragment until the schematic is whole again.
minigame.blueprint_scramble.help1: Click a fragment to rotate it 90°
minigame.blueprint_scramble.help2: When every fragment's bright corner marker sits top-left, the blueprint is solved
minigame.blueprint_scramble.hint: Click a fragment to rotate it (corner marker belongs top-left)
minigame.blueprint_scramble.title: Blueprint Scramble
minigame.cargo_sorter.card_desc: Trade-station drill: route each crate to the right cargo bay.
minigame.cargo_sorter.desc: Route each incoming crate to the matching cargo bay. Keep up as the belt speeds up — five mistakes ends the shift.
minigame.cargo_sorter.help1: Match the crate's symbol to a cargo bay
minigame.cargo_sorter.help2: ← → select, Enter confirm, or click the bay
minigame.cargo_sorter.hint: ← → choose bay · Enter confirm · or click a bay
minigame.cargo_sorter.title: Cargo Sorter
minigame.circuit_weaver.card_desc: Repair training: rotate conduits so energy reaches the receiver.
minigame.circuit_weaver.desc: Rotate the conduit tiles so energy flows from the generator to the receiver.
minigame.circuit_weaver.help1: Click any tile to rotate its lines 90°
minigame.circuit_weaver.help2: When a connected path glows from source to receiver, it's solved — fewer rotations score higher
minigame.circuit_weaver.hint: Click a tile to rotate its lines · light up the path to the receiver
minigame.circuit_weaver.title: Circuit Weaver
minigame.comet_courier.card_desc: Courier run: dodge asteroids and scoop up data packets.
minigame.comet_courier.desc: Fly the courier through the debris field, scoop up data packets and dodge asteroids. Reach the end of the run.
minigame.comet_courier.help1: ↑ ↓ or the mouse move the ship vertically
minigame.comet_courier.help2: Collect cyan data packets; asteroids cost shield. Survive the distance.
minigame.comet_courier.hint: ↑ ↓ / mouse steer · avoid asteroids · grab packets
minigame.comet_courier.title: Comet Courier
minigame.data_fishing.card_desc: Catch clean data packets, dodge the corrupted ones.
minigame.data_fishing.desc: Catch the clean data packets streaming down and let the corrupted ones pass — recover enough before the integrity is lost.
minigame.data_fishing.help1: Move the collector to catch cyan packets (gold = bonus)
minigame.data_fishing.help2: Catching a red packet costs integrity — three losses ends it
minigame.data_fishing.hint: ← → / mouse move the collector · catch cyan, avoid red
minigame.data_fishing.title: Data Fishing
minigame.docking_sim.card_desc: Precision piloting: glide gently onto the docking ring.
minigame.docking_sim.desc: Nudge the ship onto the docking ring — slowly. Too much speed on contact and you bounce off. You have three attempts.
minigame.docking_sim.help1: ↑ thrust in the facing direction; ← → rotate
minigame.docking_sim.help2: Glide into the green ring slowly — a hard hit costs an attempt
minigame.docking_sim.hint: ↑ thrust · ← → rotate · drift like in space
minigame.docking_sim.title: Docking Simulator
minigame.drone_rescue.card_desc: Pilot a repair drone: fix every node, then reach extraction.
minigame.drone_rescue.desc: Pilot the repair drone to every damaged node, then reach the extraction zone — before energy runs out.
minigame.drone_rescue.help1: Arrow keys / WASD move the drone (costs energy)
minigame.drone_rescue.help2: Step on blue energy cells to refuel, orange nodes to repair
minigame.drone_rescue.help3: Repair all nodes, then reach the green exit
minigame.drone_rescue.hint: ← ↑ ↓ → move (collect energy cells, repair nodes, reach exit)
minigame.drone_rescue.title: Drone Rescue
minigame.glyph_decoder.card_desc: Study alien glyphs, then decode their meanings from memory.
minigame.glyph_decoder.desc: Study the glyph translations, then decode them from memory before the signal fades.
minigame.glyph_decoder.help1: First a study phase shows each glyph's meaning
minigame.glyph_decoder.help2: Then choose the right meaning for each glyph
minigame.glyph_decoder.hint: Memorise the pairs, then pick the meaning for each glyph
minigame.glyph_decoder.question: WHAT DOES THIS GLYPH MEAN?
minigame.glyph_decoder.title: Alien Glyph Decoder
minigame.laser_grid.card_desc: Flip the mirrors to route the beam to the target node.

minigame.laser_grid.help2: Route the beam from the emitter to the green target
minigame.laser_grid.hint: Click a mirror to flip it ( / ↔ \ )
minigame.laser_grid.title: Laser Mirror Grid
minigame.micro_miner.card_desc: Dig for ore and surface before your energy runs out.
minigame.micro_miner.desc: Dig for ore and haul it back to the surface to bank it. Fill the quota before your energy runs dry — you'll need several trips and a tight route.
minigame.micro_miner.help1: Move into rock to dig it (costs energy); bright cells are ore.
minigame.micro_miner.help2: Return to the top surface to bank your carried ore. Reach the DEPOT quota to win — energy is limited, so plan short trips.
minigame.micro_miner.hint: ← ↑ ↓ → dig / move · surface (top row) to bank · fill the DEPOT quota
minigame.micro_miner.title: Micro Miner
minigame.nanobot_repair.card_desc: Route a nanobot across the circuit to repair every node.
minigame.nanobot_repair.desc: Route the nanobot across the circuit graph to repair every damaged node before its energy runs out. Plan the shortest path.
minigame.nanobot_repair.help1: Click a node linked to the bot to move there; moving costs energy by distance
minigame.nanobot_repair.help2: Reach every orange damaged node to repair it
minigame.nanobot_repair.hint: Click a connected node to move there (costs energy)
minigame.nanobot_repair.title: Nanobot Repair
minigame.orbit_slingshot.card_desc: Navigation training: use gravity to curve a probe into the target.
minigame.orbit_slingshot.desc: Drag from the probe to aim, then release. Use the planets' gravity to curve the probe into the target zone.
minigame.orbit_slingshot.help1: Click-drag from the probe to set direction and power
minigame.orbit_slingshot.help2: Release to launch; gravity bends the path. Reach the green target.
minigame.orbit_slingshot.hint: Drag from the probe & release to launch
minigame.orbit_slingshot.title: Orbit Slingshot
minigame.oxygen_loop.card_desc: Life-support drill: route oxygen pipes from the core to the habitat.

minigame.oxygen_loop.help1: Click any tile to rotate its lines 90°
minigame.oxygen_loop.help2: When a connected path glows from source to receiver, it's solved — fewer rotations score higher
minigame.oxygen_loop.hint: Click a tile to rotate its lines · light up the path to the receiver
minigame.oxygen_loop.title: Oxygen Loop
minigame.planet_scanner.card_desc: Pulse-scan a planet to locate its hidden signatures.
minigame.planet_scanner.desc: Pulse-scan the planet to locate hidden signatures. Each scan reveals how close you are — find them all before the scan energy is gone.
minigame.planet_scanner.help1: Click to pulse-scan; a hit marks a signature
minigame.planet_scanner.help2: A miss shows a warmth ring — orange is close, blue is far
minigame.planet_scanner.hint: Click the planet to scan — warmer = closer
minigame.planet_scanner.title: Planet Scanner
minigame.reactor_balance.card_desc: Hold the reactor gauges in their zones without a meltdown.
minigame.reactor_balance.desc: Hold every reactor gauge inside its green zone as it drifts. Keep it stable for 60 seconds without a meltdown.
minigame.reactor_balance.help2: Keep all gauges in their green zones; too long in the red trips a meltdown
minigame.reactor_balance.title: Reactor Balance
minigame.signal_tuner.card_desc: Lock onto a hidden signal and hold it steady until it decodes.
minigame.signal_tuner.desc: Adjust the parameters to lock onto the hidden signal, then hold the quality high until it decodes.
minigame.signal_tuner.help3: Keep quality above the line until the decode bar fills
minigame.signal_tuner.title: Signal Tuner
minigame.star_memory.card_desc: Navigator memory drill: find every matching chart pair.
minigame.star_memory.desc: Navigator training: flip the chart tiles two at a time and find every matching pair.
minigame.star_memory.help1: Click a card to reveal it, then a second to find its match
minigame.star_memory.hint: Click two cards to find a pair
minigame.star_memory.title: Star Map Memory
minigame.void_solitaire.card_desc: A calm card sweep — clear the board by matching pairs.
minigame.void_solitaire.desc: A quiet card sweep for the long haul. Clear the board by tapping matching pairs of symbols.
minigame.void_solitaire.help1: Click a card, then another with the same symbol — both clear
minigame.void_solitaire.help2: Clear the whole board; fewer mismatches scores higher
minigame.void_solitaire.hint: Click two matching cards to clear them
minigame.void_solitaire.title: Void Solitaire
